recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆特別大的異型細胞，核大且可見多個核仁，胞質深藍、周邊一圈排列整齊的明顯空泡，遠大於旁邊的骨髓細胞；骨髓抽吸液中出現這種大型、胞質藍帶空泡的異常細胞，要想到淋巴瘤浸潤如 ALCL。
features: Single very large atypical cell, several times the size of surrounding marrow cells
Large round nucleus with finely granular chromatin and multiple small distinct nucleoli
Deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a peripheral rim of prominent clear vacuoles
No hallmark kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nucleus evident in this cell
Background of normal maturing granulocytes, erythroid precursors and lymphocytes
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a markedly enlarged atypical cell, many times the size of adjacent hematopoietic cells, with a round nucleus, finely granular chromatin, multiple small nucleoli and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm containing a peripheral ring of prominent vacuoles. The background shows residual maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements and scattered lymphocytes. The cell is not specific on its own, as the characteristic horseshoe nucleus is not seen, but in the appropriate context it is consistent with marrow involvement by anaplastic large cell lymphoma, ALK-positive. Confirmation requires CD30 and ALK immunostains on the core biopsy or clot section.

ddx.vs: Non-hematopoietic tumor cells usually form cohesive clumps and are CD45/CD30-negative with keratin or myogenin positivity, whereas ALCL cells are single and CD30/ALK-positive.
Burkitt cells are medium-sized with basophilic cytoplasm and small uniform lipid vacuoles throughout, not giant cells with multiple nucleoli.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cell of classic Hodgkin lymphoma
ddx.vs: Reed-Sternberg cells have bilobed nuclei with huge inclusion-like nucleoli and are CD15+/PAX5 weak and ALK-negative, while ALCL is ALK+ with strong CD30 and T-cell or null phenotype.
Megakaryocytic cells show cytoplasmic blebs or granular cytoplasm and express CD61, rather than a vacuole-rimmed basophilic cytoplasm with CD30 expression.
